name: memory-performance-baseline-v0

measurements.name: local_synthetic_prefetch
measurements.scenario: personal and team_shared query plan with SpiceDB batch AuthZ
measurements.notes: Synthetic local baseline used for regression guard until P4 load tests attach live PostgreSQL, pgvector, and SpiceDB metrics.

personal.sql:
select memory_items.*
from memory_items
join memory_embeddings on memory_embeddings.memory_id = memory_items.id
where memory_items.org_id = :org_id
  and memory_items.scope = :scope
  and memory_items.status = 'active'
  and memory_items.subject_member_id = :member_id
order by memory_embeddings.embedding <=> :query_embedding
limit :limit

team_shared.sql:
select memory_items.*
from memory_items
join memory_embeddings on memory_embeddings.memory_id = memory_items.id
where memory_items.org_id = :org_id
  and memory_items.scope = :scope
  and memory_items.status = 'active'
  and memory_items.team_id = :team_id
  and memory_items.project_id = :project_id
order by memory_embeddings.embedding <=> :query_embedding
limit :limit

next_steps: Promote this baseline to live P4 load tests with real pgvector latency.
Alert when prefetch p95 exceeds 500ms for two consecutive pilot windows.
